about_the_game:
Seven years ago, the bloody battle at Zhulu Plain brought a brief period of peace to humanity. However, the undercurrents in this land have never truly subsided. A rebellion within the demon race is quietly rising, and a conspiracy under the guise of the 'Guan Yin Sect' is brewing—through drugs, desire, and mind control, it is steadily eroding the order and spirit of Jiuzhou.
You, Ethan Reed, a teacher at the Zhao Ming Academy, find yourself at the heart of this vortex of demonic unrest and imperial intrigue. Torn between power and justice, wavering between life, death, and emotion, what truths lie hidden beneath the layers of mist? And will Jiuzhou's ultimate fate align with your hopes?
Every choice you make will shape your destiny and alter Jiuzhou's future. Embark on this passionate journey and write your own legendary chapter. The fate of Jiuzhou rests in your hands!

Game Features：

1. Immersive Narrative Experience
The game features rich textual storytelling, drawing you into the world of Jiuzhou, a land filled with conflicts and emotions, through detailed descriptions, dialogues, and events. You'll feel the joys and sorrows of every character as you navigate this intricate world.
2. Complex Character Relationship Network
Each character in the game has a unique background and motivation, such as Damian Blackwood's ruthless ambition or Julian Whitmore's integrity and restraint. These characters not only drive the plot forward but also form deep bonds and conflicts with you, the protagonist.
3. A Fusion of Historical Background and Fantasy Setting
Set in the world of Jiuzhou, the game blends the racial conflicts of humans, demons, and spirits with elements of ancient political intrigue and fantasy. This creates a world that feels both authentic and fantastical.

Game Rules：

1. Text-based Interaction and Multiple Endings
You will progress through the story by reading text and making choices at critical moments. These choices will affect the bond values between characters, the storyline, and the final outcome.
2. Bond Value Management
You need to manage the bond values with different characters through dialogue and actions. Each character's bond value influences the progression of the story and can even determine their life, death, or attitude.
3. Attribute Growth Management
Your choices also affect the growth of your personal attributes. Whether you become a dedicated and hardworking teacher or shine as a protagonist with a dazzling aura depends on your decisions.

short_description: Bound by Celestial Fate is a RPG set in a fantasy world inspired by ancient China. As Ethan Reed, a witty & justice-driven teacher, lead students through perilous adventures in turbulent Jiuzhou. Use strategy and bonds to shape a story of intrigue, humanity, and emotional depth amid power struggles.
supported_languages: English, French, German, Russian, Indonesian, Thai, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Portugal, Spanish - Latin America, Vietnamese
